coverageAssessment.claimedScope: UP BhuNaksha exposes village hierarchy, georeferenced extents, plot hit-testing and WMS for some rural villages. The WUP city center did not resolve into either nearby sample village; no urban parcel coverage established.

technicalBlocker: Nearby public hit-test results provide parcel codes and bounding boxes only. The full-shape endpoint and GeoJSON layer endpoint return 401; the WMS evidence is a raster.
remainingUncertainty: No public, nonempty parcel polygon associated with the exact WUP target point was verified.
nextStep: Use a separately documented public vector route if one becomes available; validate full boundaries, geographic placement and fresh native-ID or source-scoped geometry-reference reads. Preserve the nearby public raster as viewing evidence only.

priorEvidence.summary: Earlier city assessment retained in referenced file; not duplicated in this batch record.
